species.name: Cinderfox
species.identity: A glassy fox that cashes out burn windows.
species.loop: Tag with Wickshot, approach under flare, cash out burn with Kindlebite.
species.counterplay: Dodge the tag and re-engage after the burn expires; the fox has no heal.
species.learning_test: Withhold the finisher until burn is active; stop chasing through enemy terrain.

species.name: Brambleback
species.identity: A rooted hedgehog that becomes expensive to evict.
species.loop: Set a garden, stop moving to grow a shield, use roots to hold the bloom.
species.counterplay: Force relocation with remote damage; do not fight inside the garden.
species.learning_test: Choose when immobility is worth its defenses.

species.name: Glasswing
species.identity: A brittle dragonfly whose cannon rewards stillness.
species.loop: Establish distance, charge focus by standing, fire through narrow lanes.
species.counterplay: Cross the minimum range during a long windup; force repeated turns and moves.
species.learning_test: Find safe stationary firing windows without abandoning the objective.

species.name: Voltjack
species.identity: A conductive jackal that turns wet tags into dive windows.
species.loop: Mark with Spark Pin, cross the gap, discharge marks at close range.
species.counterplay: Spread the engage and deny the mark; dry conditions reduce its spike.
species.learning_test: Choose between ranged probing and a committed marked-target dive.

species.name: Miretoad
species.identity: A squat toad whose poison needs repeated access.
species.loop: Apply venom at several ranges, maintain stacks, heal while the poison works.
species.counterplay: Break contact long enough for stacks to expire, then burst the slow body.
species.learning_test: Preserve stacks without trading all of its health for one extra hit.

species.name: Basaltusk
species.identity: A heavy boar that wants the opponent between tusks and stone.
species.loop: Approach facing threats, pull into range, drive the opponent into terrain.
species.counterplay: Flank the frontal armor; leave a lateral escape before the ram.
species.learning_test: Line up wall collisions instead of charging directly at every target.

species.name: Rimehare
species.identity: A fast hare that converts repeated slows into brief roots.
species.loop: Clip approach paths, build chill through repeat tags, escape before commitment.
species.counterplay: Bait the escape then attack from another angle; its direct burst is low.
species.learning_test: Lead lateral movement and conserve dodge for the engage.

species.name: Gloamcat
species.identity: A shadow cat paid for reaching the unguarded side.
species.loop: Blink across a firing angle, mark the prey, punish from behind.
species.counterplay: Track the blink endpoint and rotate your facing; punish missed lunges.
species.learning_test: Reason about opponent orientation rather than only distance.

species.name: Ironmoth
species.identity: A metal moth that reflects a projectile during guard.
species.loop: Threaten reflective guard to buy space; punish the opponent for waiting.
species.counterplay: Use beams, zones or a melee approach, and bait the guard first.
species.learning_test: Time a guard to projectile arrival rather than cast start.

species.name: Tidecoil
species.identity: An eel that is faster and more sustainable on wet ground.
species.loop: Pull enemies into a pool and hold a favorable close-mid range.
species.counterplay: Dodge the pull, leave the pool, and capitalize on dry-weather weakness.
species.learning_test: Compensate for wind and choose pull angles that do not help the enemy.

species.name: Quillrat
species.identity: A small rodent paid for convincing enemies to take a route.
species.loop: Place visible traps near likely paths; herd with shots and knockback.
species.counterplay: Clear or route around trap circles and attack before the field is prepared.
species.learning_test: Predict future positions rather than planting directly under the current enemy.

species.name: Sunstag
species.identity: A stag that turns a defensive cleanse into tempo.
species.loop: Absorb a debuff, cleanse it, use the haste window to control center.
species.counterplay: Delay crowd control until cleanse is gone; contest its long-cooldown recovery.
species.learning_test: Distinguish valuable cleanse timing from using every spell on cooldown.

species.name: Gravemole
species.identity: A burrowing mole that empowers its next hit after displacement.
species.loop: Show a delayed eruption, blink to a new line, land the empowered attack.
species.counterplay: Move out of the eruption and hold defense for the post-blink hit.
species.learning_test: Coordinate delayed ground damage with its own arrival.

species.name: Prismray
species.identity: A ray that makes walls into indirect firing lanes.
species.loop: Bank shots around rocks, then exploit forced sidesteps with a narrow beam.
species.counterplay: Fight in open space or close the gap while the bank shot travels.
species.learning_test: Discover wall angles and distinguish return paths from initial aim.

species.name: Thornmantis
species.identity: A mantis that invests in a wound before its real trade.
species.loop: Open a wound, stick briefly, cash out a high-damage cut.
species.counterplay: Kite the short blades and wait out the wound before using a heal.
species.learning_test: Sequence setup and payoff while preserving an exit.

species.name: Mosswarden
species.identity: A moss-covered giant that heals only while owning a patch.
species.loop: Seed shelter on the objective, defend it, replenish slowly between trades.
species.counterplay: Displace it out of the shelter or apply wounds before committing damage.
species.learning_test: Weigh staying inside a heal zone against avoiding incoming area attacks.

species.name: Galecrest
species.identity: A crestbird that turns wind into unusually fast rotations.
species.loop: Sweep the opponent off a line, reposition, send a fan into their exit.
species.counterplay: Use terrain to shorten its strafe path and exploit its thin health pool.
species.learning_test: Learn different projectile leads and approach paths in each weather preset.

species.name: Ashram
species.identity: A ram that pays real health to create lethal windows.
species.loop: Spend health to enter, exploit missing-health damage, extract through a small heal.
species.counterplay: Deny the last hit, disengage through its haste, punish reckless self-costs.
species.learning_test: Estimate whether the all-in wins before sacrificing its safety buffer.

species.name: Clockfin
species.identity: A clockwork fish paid for changing spell slots.
species.loop: Alternate cheap tools with expensive payoffs to recover energy.
species.counterplay: Force a repeated defensive spell or interrupt the slow payoff.
species.learning_test: Learn a flexible sequence instead of a fixed highest-DPS button.

species.name: Nullurchin
species.identity: An urchin that punishes protective-resource dependence.
species.loop: Strip shields with safe pokes, silence a recovery spell, take ground.
species.counterplay: Offer raw health instead of shields and pressure its poor mobility.
species.learning_test: Identify when disruption matters more than the largest damage number.

species.name: Waxwyrm
species.identity: A wax wyrm whose strength has a separate health bar.
species.loop: Build a turret with crossfire, defend it with slows and body positioning.
species.counterplay: Aim at the turret to destroy it before fighting in its lane.
species.learning_test: Place summons where their line of sight and survival both matter.

species.name: Ribbonape
species.identity: A ribbon-tailed ape that hits along outbound and return paths.
species.loop: Throw a ribbon, change position, make the returning arc cross the enemy.
species.counterplay: Step off the return line rather than blindly dodging the first pass.
species.learning_test: Use locomotion to steer an existing projectile.

species.name: Saltcrab
species.identity: A crab that replenishes stamina during guard.
species.loop: Block while refilling, then spend a full bar to bully a short-range fight.
species.counterplay: Wait out the shell and attack while it is spending; displace it off center.
species.learning_test: Use defensive downtime as a resource reset rather than permanent turtling.

species.name: Nectarbat
species.identity: A bat that survives by landing risky direct hits.
species.loop: Take repeated short trades, heal on contact, exit before crowd control lands.
species.counterplay: Apply wounds or deny contact; its sustain vanishes while kited.
species.learning_test: Select safe access windows instead of interpreting lifesteal as permission to face-tank.

species.name: Bellox
species.identity: A bell-backed ox whose third direct hit rings louder.
species.loop: Land two reliable taps, line up a decisive third contact.
species.counterplay: Break its contact rhythm and force the third hit into a guard.
species.learning_test: Track a persistent hit counter through movement and cooldown choices.

species.name: Anvilnewt
species.identity: A newt that forges stronger blows while shielded.
species.loop: Prepare a shield, enter while it lasts, choose whether to risk losing the damage buff.
species.counterplay: Poke away the shield before the real exchange; use anti-shield tools.
species.learning_test: Treat shield as both survival and an expiring offensive resource.

species.name: Duneskink
species.identity: A skink that stores actual distance traveled for the next strike.
species.loop: Circle to build momentum, spend it in a short trade, move again.
species.counterplay: Pin it or force it to fight before it has moved enough.
species.learning_test: Plan paths with tactical purpose rather than running in place for charge.

species.name: Kelpwidow
species.identity: A long-limbed widow that keeps prey at a precise intermediate range.
species.loop: Tag from distance, pull toward a prepared patch, punish attempts to flee.
species.counterplay: Commit fully through its preferred ring; do not oscillate on its strongest range.
species.learning_test: Maintain a distance band under pressure rather than maximize distance.

species.name: Pyrelisk
species.identity: A lizard that becomes stronger and slower as it casts.
species.loop: Build heat safely, spend its amplified area damage before being surrounded.
species.counterplay: Force mobility at high heat or wait while the heat drains.
species.learning_test: Decide when another cast is worth losing movement speed.

species.name: Mooncalf
species.identity: A calf that stores shield damage for a later direct hit.
species.loop: Offer a shielded trade, preserve the stored force, choose a reliable counterstrike.
species.counterplay: Stop hitting the shield or force its next attack to miss.
species.learning_test: Remember shield absorption and distinguish damage bait from a losing trade.

species.name: Coppergecko
species.identity: A gecko whose every third cast refunds stamina.
species.loop: Use a cheap tool to approach the refund, then spend on a high-cost spell.
species.counterplay: Pressure it between refunds and deny low-risk filler casts.
species.learning_test: Plan the cast counter and avoid wasting refunds at full energy.

species.name: Orchardboar
species.identity: A boar that receives a heal when its garden expires naturally.
species.loop: Plant ahead of the fight, survive until harvest, then contest again.
species.counterplay: Kill it before the payout; destroying turrets does not count as a harvest.
species.learning_test: Track zone lifetimes and avoid taking a fight too early.

species.name: Inkheron
species.identity: A heron whose own ink zones consume hostile projectiles.
species.loop: Put ink between itself and a shooter, then exploit the safe firing angle.
species.counterplay: Use beams, melee or walk around the cover; smoke is visible and not stealth.
species.learning_test: Distinguish projectile cover from safety against all attack kinds.

species.name: Hooklynx
species.identity: A lynx that wants to hook a marked target rather than any target.
species.loop: Tag with a cheap dart, hook into claw range, cash out the mark.
species.counterplay: Break line of sight after the tag and punish a missed hook recovery.
species.learning_test: Wait for a high-value hook instead of firing it at maximum range every time.

species.name: Slagjaw
species.identity: A corrosive jaw that makes all contact compromise healing.
species.loop: Keep wounds on the opponent and take extended trades their heals cannot erase.
species.counterplay: Take short burst trades and deny repeated contact rather than relying on recovery.
species.learning_test: Identify sustain windows and keep access without overchasing.

species.name: Dewotter
species.identity: An otter whose dodge removes slows and damage-over-time effects.
species.loop: Invite a debuff, cleanse through dodge, return while the enemy setup is down.
species.counterplay: Bait dodge before applying the important debuff; use silence carefully.
species.learning_test: Value cleanse timing while still respecting dodge stamina.

species.name: Echofin
species.identity: A sonar fish paid for casting within a particular rhythm.
species.loop: Space casts at roughly one-second intervals, then line up a broad payoff.
species.counterplay: Interrupt its timing by forcing defense or denying range on the beat.
species.learning_test: Learn temporal rhythm rather than pure cooldown greed.

species.name: Latchspider
species.identity: A spider whose own zones accelerate it.
species.loop: Lay a route of webs, fight while moving along it, pull enemies across it.
species.counterplay: Force it out of the network or contest before it has placed safe routes.
species.learning_test: Use terrain as a locomotion network rather than a stationary damage patch.

species.name: Flintroc
species.identity: A roc that charges a powerful shot by not attacking.
species.loop: Hold fire to charge, select a good lane, then reposition while reloading.
species.counterplay: Pressure during its reload and force it to spend charge on a poor shot.
species.learning_test: Trade shot frequency for reliability and avoid dumping charge into a dodge.

species.name: Oathhound
species.identity: A hound that resists interruption during guard and rewards a successful block.
species.loop: Present a guarded threat, absorb contact, answer with an empowered strike.
species.counterplay: Feint the guard and use displacement or long-range pressure instead of feeding it.
species.learning_test: Read commitment and distinguish an incoming hit from a harmless telegraph.
